div.head: III Atr 13.4
div.ab: Et qui super id ladam prorogat uel qui dat, reddat sex dimidiam marcam
⁊ se ðe ofer ðæt láde geþafie oððe se þe hy sylle, gilde VI healfmarc.
⁊ se ðe ofer ðæt láde geþafie oððe se þe hy sylle, gilde VI healfmarc.
And he who subsequently permits a man to clear himself [of a transaction], and [likewise] he who offers to clear himself shall pay 6 half-marks.
And he who in spite of it admits exculpation, or he who offers it, is to pay six half-marks.
Und wer trotzdem [dem Gegner] Reinigungsbeweis gestattet oder wer ihn [ihm] ablegt, büsse 6 Halbmark.
And whoever, despite that, allows [his opponent] proof by clearing, or whoever gives it [to him], let him pay 6 half-marks.
